The '''Peppel system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Peppel]], on which [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] captured the fugitive [[Kardue'sai'Malloc/Legends|Kardue'sai'Malloc]] in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].<ref name="The Last One Standing" />
